slides.title: What Happened
slides.body: The Dow gained 5.5% this week, its best since October 2022. The S&P 500 rose 5.6% and the Nasdaq 6.7% after the prior week's rout.

slides.title: A Big Rebound Week
slides.subtitle: Weekly change through Nov 27, %
slides.body: Friday close (1 p.m. ET): Dow 50,774.94, S&P 500 7,297.49.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: The 10-year Treasury yield rose from 4.86% on Friday. Traders still expect more Fed rate hikes, so borrowing costs stay the risk behind the rally.
